units: <cite ref="Berakhot 32a:11-24">Ber. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>מה … חי וק׳ … אף שבועתך ק׳ וכ׳</he> as thy great name lives and endures for ever and ever, so thy oath holds good for ever and ever; opp. <cite ref="B00515"><he>בָּטֵל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:3:8">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵇ</cite> bot., a. e., v. <cite ref="M00537"><he>מוֹנִיטָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 69a:6">Ned. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ ליכי ק׳ ליכי</he> if the husband said twice, thy vow is valid (confirmed by me), opp. <he>מופר</he>.

<cite ref="Gittin 88a:21">Gitt. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>ועדיין … ק׳</he> while those exiled under Jeconiah are yet alive; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קַיָּימִים</he>, <he>קַיָּימִין</he>; <he>קַיָּימוֹת</he>; <cite ref="S01000"><he>קַיָּמ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 8:5">B. Bath. VIII, 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>דבריו ק׳</he> his words (testamentary dispositions) are valid, opp. <he>לא אמר כלום</he>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:5">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>משה רבינו</he> … <he>וק׳ הם וכ׳</he> Moses, our teacher, has issued many decrees and introduced many institutions, and they endure for ever and ever; a. fr.
